label: Говорящий
description: A 10-sentence card for говорящий, the present active participle of говорить.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Говорящий is built from говорить through the present stem of говорят plus -щ- and an ending. It agrees with masculine человек and means the man who is speaking.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets говорящая agree with женщина. It marks the woman who is talking at this moment.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Говорящее takes the neuter ending -ее to match the neuter noun радио, describing the radio that is talking.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ие joins говорящие to гости, picking out the guests who are talking around the table.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the animate object гостя the participle takes -его, so говорящего agrees in gender, number and case as the guest I am listening to.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Говорящей carries the feminine genitive ending to agree with женщины, marking whose voice it is — the voice of the woman who is speaking.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative object другу draws говорящему into the dative -ему ending, naming the friend who is speaking and whom we trust.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After любуюсь the noun ребёнком is instrumental, and говорящим takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the speaking child.
Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so попугае and говорящем both take prepositional endings as the parrot we think about.

Strategic focus: Masculine nominative paraphrase. Говорящий по-русски турист unfolds as турист, который говорит по-русски — the tourist who speaks Russian. The participle folds that который-clause into one agreeing word.
